title: Tour du Mont Blanc
who: Classic route · France, Italy and Switzerland on foot
when: Late June to early September, when the huts are open
summary: A loop of about 170 km and 10,000 m of climbing round the Mont Blanc massif, through three countries: high cols, glaciers in view almost every day, and nights in mountain refuges where dinner is shared. Book the huts months ahead.

sources.label: Patrick Lam: TMB trip report, July–August 2025
Kenji Saito: TMB day by day (September 2025)

approximate: The classic anticlockwise stages; the line follows mountain paths near the official route.

stops.name: Les Houches
stops.text: The traditional start, at the bottom of the Chamonix valley. Anticlockwise, like most walkers.

stops.name: Les Contamines
stops.text: Over the Col de Voza and past the Bionnassay glacier.

stops.name: Croix du Bonhomme
stops.place: Refuge de la Croix du Bonhomme
stops.text: Up the old Roman road to the Col du Bonhomme and a hut at almost 2,500 m.

stops.name: Les Mottets
stops.text: Down to the Vallée des Glaciers and a refuge in old farm buildings.

stops.name: Courmayeur
stops.text: Col de la Seigne into Italy, the south face of Mont Blanc opening up, and a rest day in Courmayeur.

photo.credit: Hagai Agmon-Snir حچاي اچمون-سنير חגי אגמון-שניר

stops.name: Rifugio Bonatti
stops.text: A balcony path above Val Ferret facing the Grandes Jorasses, one of the finest days of the tour.

stops.name: La Fouly
stops.text: Over the Grand Col Ferret, the highest point at 2,537 m, into Switzerland.

stops.name: Champex
stops.text: Gentle walking through Swiss villages to a lake resort.

photo.credit: Olivier Bruchez Camera location46° 01′ 37.24″ N, 7° 07′ 05.11″ E View this and other nearby images on: OpenStreetMap 46.

stops.name: Trient
stops.text: Over the Bovine alp or the Fenêtre d'Arpette, the wild alternative under the Trient glacier.

stops.name: Tré-le-Champ
stops.text: Col de Balme back into France, with the whole Chamonix valley ahead.

stops.name: Lac Blanc
stops.text: Ladders up the Aiguilles Rouges to the lake where Mont Blanc is reflected.

stops.name: Back in Les Houches
stops.text: Along the Grand Balcon Sud and down by the Brévent: the loop closed.
